notes.title: v2.0.0 Full Release
notes.notes:
Additions:
- Ancient Core (Boss at the center of the fortress)
- Ancient Laser (Dropped from the Ancient Core)

Changes:
- Slightly reduced the durability of the Ancient Robot

Fixes:
- Fixed an issue where post-processing effects were not applied to the third-person camera view

notes.title: v1.12.0 Robot Update
notes.notes:
Additions:
- Ancient Robots (emerge from ancient robot makers)  
- Ancient Ceramics (can sometimes be found in the possession of ancient robots)  
- Baked Apples (obtained by heating apples)  

Changes:
- Transistors, trigger switches, and capacitors now drop from robots instead of self-destructing drones  
- Objects that take more than 10 times their maximum durability in blast damage will now disappear  
- Slightly increased the strength of iron

notes.title: v1.8.0 Space Update
notes.notes:
Additions:
Sky Ruins
Mixed Acid (can be synthesized from Niter and Yellow Slime)
Nitrocellulose (can be synthesized from Mixed Acid and Dry Grass)
Ancient Rocket Engine (available in Aerial Ruins, generates thrust while consuming Nitrocellulose and being electrically powered)
Space (becomes weightless above a certain altitude)
Moon (generated above the starting point)
Moon Rock (has the same properties as terrestrial stone)
Re-calibration feature (allows switching between standing and sitting play mid-game)
Volume control feature
Footstep and water sound effects
Note: Aerial ruins and the moon are generated even in already explored areas of existing save data.

Changes:
Modified how music plays and added new tracks (new tracks are from stock music, so they will not be added to the soundtrack)
Made the trigger operation exclusively for bonding, not for bonding and separation
Changed swimming controls (thrust is generated only when the hand is open and moved palm-side)
Prevented living Yellow Slime from being used as synthesis material
Burnt objects are now considered less in synthesis and blueprint materials
Slowed down the rate of atmospheric pressure decrease with altitude
Increased the amount of Niter dropped from Green Slime
Changed the drop from Ancient Suicide Drone Maker from engines to Niter

Fixes:
Fixed the issue where batteries and similar items intermittently conduct electricity when connected sideways
Fixed the issue where the menu cannot be operated during high-speed movement
Fixed the issue of small objects being difficult to grab
Fixed the issue of creating thinner than limit objects using synthesis
Other minor fixes

notes.title: Extension of the Early Access Period and Upcoming Update Plans
notes.notes:
The initial early access period for Primitier was planned for 1-2 years. However, due to missing elements such as variations in mobs, we are expecting to extend the period by about a year. Thus, the official release is now anticipated to be around the end of 2024 to the beginning of 2025.
For the full version, we plan to add mainly the following elements:

- Mobs smarter than slimes and drones
- Fortress boss
- Creative mode
- Logic circuit system (this may be added in an update after the full release)

We appreciate your continued support for Primitier.

notes.title: v1.7.0 Blueprint Update
notes.notes:
Additions:
- Blueprint System: You can launch the Blueprint UI from the left-hand menu. By registering a blueprint of an object, you can automatically create the same object by consuming equivalent materials and electricity.

Changes:
- Switched the input system from SteamVR Input to OpenXR
- Changed the VIVE controller's grab action to grip toggle, and the join action to trigger
- Separation action can now be done with the A/X button on Touch controllers and the A button on Index controllers
- Other minor adjustments

Fixes:
- Fixed the issue where the block would be released from the hand after breaking

Blueprint data is saved in Documents\Primitier\Saves\Blueprints and can be shared with other players by transferring files.
Added to the guidelines that blueprint data can be shared.

notes.title: v1.5.0 Electric Update
notes.notes:
Features
- Electricity: Electricity flows when a block that generates electricity and a block that consumes electricity are connected directly or with conductors
- Ancient electric motor: The shaft rotates when electricity is applied. Electricity is generated when the shaft is reversed
- Ancient battery: Can store electricity. Charging and discharging are switched depending on the connection direction
- Ancient LED: Lights up when electricity is applied. There are two types, large and small, and the larger one can illuminate the surroundings
- Ancient solar cell: Generates electricity when exposed to sunlight. The more vertical the exposure, the more electricity is generated
- Tungsten ore: Changes to tungsten when heated
- Tungsten: Heats up when electricity is applied. It has higher attack power than iron. Forgeable at 1200℃
- New property of pyrite: Conducts electricity in only one direction
- Ancient lightweight plastic*: As light as dry grass and less flammable than dry grass
- Ancient wind turbine: A structure with motor, battery and LED
- Ancient buoy: A structure with solar cell, battery and LED. Generated in oceans with a certain depth
* In the old version, the material name of the drone was "ancient lightweight plastic", but it is a different material

Adjustments
- Changed the name of the ancient drone material from "ancient lightweight plastic" to "ancient drone"
- Made the night darker
- Increased player movement speed slightly
- Increased the combustion heat and heat dissipation speed of objects, and decreased the heat transfer speed between objects
- Heat is now transferred between the bearing axis and the outer ring
- The higher the altitude, the less air resistance and lift an object receives
- Decreased the bounciness of rubber slightly
- Adjusted the angle of the menu window
- Adjusted the angle of the first person camera
- Other minor adjustments have been made

Fixes
- Fixed a bug where heat was sometimes not transferred to objects in contact

notes.title: Demo Version Update
notes.notes:
The demo version now reflects updates up to v1.4.1.
As before, the demo version has the following limitations:
- Cannot save and load
- Movement range limitation
- Fixed terrain seed value
